name: Crystal in the Mountains
summary: In Arathi's northern mountains, a vision draws you toward a gleaming crystal. The Pendant of Myzrael pulses in your hand as a plea for help reaches you.

sections.title: A Silent Plea
sections.body: The Pendant of Myzrael pulses in your hand, carrying a plea from someone in need of help. Then a vision shows a gleaming crystal thrusting from the ground in the mountains north of Arathi. You feel drawn there.

sections.title: At the Crystal
sections.body: At the crystal, its pulse suggests a living force is trapped within.

aliases: how to get crystal in the mountains
where does pendant of myzrael come from
faq.answer: The Pendant of Myzrael begins this journey. As you hold it, it pulses with a plea from someone in desperate need of help.
The vision leads you to a gleaming crystal in Arathi's northern mountains. You feel drawn there.
